info.title: Molt interface specification
info.summary: Every Collector route, every Web_Console route, and every Molt_MCP_Server tool as one document.
info.description: One document covers three surfaces so the vocabulary is not split across three. Because two surfaces serve a route at the same served path, each path key here is namespaced by its surface and the served path is stated on every operation as `x-molt-path`. Read `x-molt-surface` to know which process answers, `x-molt-path` to know what a caller requests, `x-molt-authentication` to know what the request must carry, and `x-molt-mutation` to know whether the route changes stored state. An operation that takes neither a parameter nor a body states `x-molt-request-shape` as `empty` rather than leaving the request shape unstated. Response schemas under `text/html` describe the view model a rendered page presents, which is that page's response shape; response schemas under `application/json` describe the serialised body. The command-line verbs are listed under `x-molt-cli` because they are a caller surface with no path of their own. This document names shapes only: it carries no memory content, no identifier of any stored row, and no example drawn from a corpus.

collector.description: The ingest and recall endpoint an engineer machine reaches over HTTPS, holding no database credential of its own.

console.description: The Web_Console, whose every content route requires a session and whose mutation routes are refused in demonstration mode.

tools.description: The Molt_MCP_Server tool registry, described as one operation per tool so argument and result schemas live beside the route schemas.

x-molt-authentication-kinds.none: The route answers a caller carrying nothing. Reserved for the liveness route and this document's own route, neither of which reads a table.
x-molt-authentication-kinds.bearer: A bearer token, verified before the request is read.
x-molt-authentication-kinds.bearer+signature: A bearer token and an Ingress_Signature over the body. Both ingest routes require both.
x-molt-authentication-kinds.session: A console session cookie. A mutation additionally requires the session's own token in the submitted form.
x-molt-authentication-kinds.tool-session: An established Molt_MCP_Server session, whose permitted Client set is configured rather than requested.

x-molt-cli.description: The command-line verbs, one entry per verb as the argument tree declares it. Two-word verbs are stated as two words.

verbs.name: attest verify
verbs.summary: verify a certificate or a checkpoint

verbs.name: verify-chain
verbs.summary: verify one hash chain by recomputation

bearerToken.description: The ingest credential. Tenancy is re-derived from the presented principal rather than read from the request.

ingressSignature.name: X-Molt-Signature
ingressSignature.description: The Ingress_Signature over the request body, required by both ingest routes and by neither read route.

consoleSession.name: molt_session
consoleSession.description: The console session cookie, signed and absolutely expiring.

Unauthorized.description: The request carried no acceptable credential, or the console session was absent, edited, or expired.

Forbidden.description: The credential was accepted and the action was refused: an invalid Ingress_Signature, a Client outside the permitted set, a missing session token on a mutation, or a mutation attempted while demonstration mode is enabled.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The declared or transported body exceeds the configured bound, so no record of the batch was read.

Unavailable.description: A dependency this route needs did not answer, or the tracked document this route serves could not be read. The body names no path and no host.

NotImplemented.description: The route is declared with its posture stated and its view is not yet claimed. Returned only after the authentication check, so an unclaimed route is never an unauthenticated one.

ErrorReport.description: Every refusal and every unavailability in one shape, naming the condition and nothing about the deployment.

error.description: The condition, named in words a caller can act on.

detail.description: What the caller may correct, carrying no path, host, or stored value.

EventBatchAccepted.description: What one ingest batch produced: how many records were persisted and why each refused record was refused.

reasons.description: One entry per refused record, naming the record's position and the reason class.

SessionMetadata.description: The Session a machine declares, whose tenancy the Collector re-derives rather than trusts.

created.description: Whether this request opened the Session rather than updated it.

RecallQuery.description: A recall request. The permitted Client set is configured, so no field here can widen it.

k.description: Rows asked for, answered at the configured maximum when it exceeds it.

HealthReport.description: Liveness, cluster reachability, the capability record, and the mode flag. Reads no memory row.

capabilities.description: The capability record the store holds.

TierView.description: One row per tier, each tier told apart by its own text label rather than by colour, plus the working tier's two expiry figures.

tiers.description: The descriptive columns and the live count, one entry per tier.

purpose.description: What the tier holds, in prose.

mutability.description: Whether rows in the tier may change after they are written.

capability.description: What the tier makes possible that the others do not.

retention.description: How long a row survives in the tier, in prose.

live_rows.description: The count read live rather than cached.

working_expired_rows.description: Working tier rows past their expiry that the sweep has not yet removed.

working_next_sweep_seconds.description: Seconds until the next working-tier sweep, as a duration rather than a wall reading.

RecalledRow.description: One recalled prior attempt with its outcome and the confidence of the procedure it supports.

LineageAncestorRow.description: One ancestor of a named Artifact, reported with its kind.

LineageDescendantRow.description: One descendant of a named Artifact.

ResidueCandidateRow.description: One residue candidate with its distance, its band, and the recorded reason for its disposition.

ToolAnswer.description: What one tool invocation produced. An unreachable cluster answers with no row and a note rather than by ending the session.

RenderedPage.description: A rendered page whose view model is stated on the operation that serves it.

post.summary: Ingest one batch of Events, one record per line.

requestBody.description: Newline-separated Event records. A record the reader refuses is reported rather than failing the batch.

schema.description: One Event document per line, each carrying its Session, its kind, and its body.

200.description: The batch was read and the readable records were persisted.

put.summary: Open or update one Session's metadata.

200.description: The Session exists with the declared metadata.

post.summary: Recall prior work semantically. Bearer only: it reads and writes nothing.

200.description: The rows the query reached, bounded by the configured maximum.

get.summary: Liveness and cluster reachability. Unauthenticated because it reads no table.

200.description: The endpoint is live, with the reachability answer stated rather than implied.

get.summary: liveness, database reachability, capability record, and the mode flag

200.description: The console is live. An unreachable cluster is reported as degraded rather than as a failure.

get.summary: the tracked Interface_Specification document, served verbatim

200.description: This document, byte for byte as it is tracked. No table is read and no memory content is returned.
One labelled credential input and one submit control.

post.summary: verify the operator credential and issue the session cookie

303.description: The credential verified and a signed, absolutely expiring session cookie was issued.
The session is revoked and the caller is returned to the credential form.

200.description: One row per live Session with its machine, its agent tool, and its Event count.

get.summary: the Event stream of one Session with chain verification status

200.description: The Session's Events in order, with the recomputed chain status stated per Event.

get.summary: the Lineage_Graph view, filterable by Client

parameters.name: client
parameters.description: Narrow the graph to one Client.

200.description: The graph with its nodes and edges, each edge naming its relation.

get.summary: the ancestor and descendant subgraph of one Artifact

200.description: The Artifact's ancestors and descendants, each with its kind.

get.summary: semantic residue search with cosine distances

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows asked for, held at or below the configured maximum.

200.description: The candidates with their distances and bands, as the residue policy classified them.

get.summary: the Threshold_Grid view of the Sensitivity_Analyzer report

200.description: One grid cell per threshold pair, each stating its counts.

get.summary: Learned_Procedure standing with the change history per procedure

200.description: Each procedure with its confidence, its standing, and the recorded changes behind it.

get.summary: the Memory_Tier view with live per-tier counts

200.description: One row per tier with its descriptive columns and its live count, plus the working tier's expired-row count and the seconds until its next sweep.

get.summary: the erasure console: Client picker, thresholds, dry-run toggle

200.description: The form: a Client picker, the two thresholds, and the dry-run toggle.

post.summary: record an Erasure_Run and return its identifier

303.description: The run is recorded and the caller is sent to its detail page.

get.summary: phase progress streamed from the durable phase and disposition rows

200.description: One event per phase transition, read from the durable rows rather than from process memory.
The run with its phases and one Disposition per Artifact, each naming its reason.

get.summary: the before and after comparison of one Blended_Artifact body

200.description: The body as it stood and as it stands, with the redacted spans marked.
The certificate's counts, its named checkpoint, and its signature standing.

post.summary: trigger a live verification and display the outcome

200.description: The verification outcome, stated as passed or failed with the disagreeing figure named.

get.summary: per-Client Jurisdiction, interval, and expiring and expired counts

200.description: One row per Client with its Jurisdiction, its interval, and its two counts.
The queued approvals, each with what it would change and who asked.

303.description: The approval is resolved and the queue is shown again.

post.summary: Recall prior attempts and their outcomes similar to a described action.

query_text.description: A natural-language description of the intended action.

limit.description: How many rows to return, held at or below the configured maximum.

200.description: The recalled rows, or no row and a note when the cluster did not answer.

post.summary: Retrieve the lineage ancestors of the named Artifacts.

artifact_ids.description: The Artifacts whose ancestors are asked for.

limit.description: How many rows to return, held at or below the configured maximum.

200.description: The permitted ancestors of the named Artifacts.

post.summary: Retrieve the lineage descendants of the named Artifacts.

artifact_ids.description: The Artifacts whose descendants are asked for.

limit.description: How many rows to return, held at or below the configured maximum.

200.description: The permitted descendants of the named Artifacts.

post.summary: Search residue candidates for one erasure run, recording nothing.

run_id.description: The erasure run whose candidate set seeds the search.

limit.description: How many rows to return, held at or below the configured maximum.

200.description: The candidates with their distances, their bands, and the reason recorded for each.
